title: The fixed rule on net1 v4, validation links: the u grid on two more campaign seeds
description: On the guest with the original setups' TCP settings, the whole validation rerun (exp-rule-net1v4-val-43, campaign seed 11) puts u = 0.25 ahead of u = 0.125 by 0.008 in the mean over the five families, where exp-rule-net1v4-val-11 had u = 0.125 ahead by 0.002. The difference is far inside the intervals, so the choice is confirmed over seeds before anything built on u = 0.125 is changed: the same u grid for the rule on net1 v4 (u in -0.25, 0, 0.125, 0.25, 0.375, 0.5), with BBRv3, on the same 21 validation links and five families, with campaign seeds 21 and 31 (new episode seeds and condition draws). Each seed's report is in s21/ and s31/.
prepare: G="$IN/grid/$(cat "$IN/grid/chosen.txt")/net1.pt"; U="-0.25 0 0.125 0.25 0.375 0.5"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/v4" "$G" --u $U; P=(); for u in $U; do P+=(--policy "v4-u$u=$OUT/v4/rule-u$u.onnx"); done; for s in 21 31; do mkdir -p "$OUT/s$s"; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT/s$s" val $s $s bbr3 "${P[@]}"; done
run: for c in "$OUT"/s*/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done
collect: for s in 21 31; do uv run python experiments/rule_report.py "$OUT/s$s" --select v4; done; { echo '# Campaign seed 21'; cat "$OUT/s21/summary.md"; echo; echo '# Campaign seed 31'; cat "$OUT/s31/summary.md"; } > "$OUT/summary.md"
